title: External contractor looks up their own company's contact
userProblem: I'm Dana at Echo Financial. I need Wei Chen's contact details — he's our Risk Analyst. What's his email and phone?

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches contacts scoped to Echo Financial, finds con_008 (Wei Chen), and answers with his email and phone number.

assertions.description: Agent must look the contact up rather than answer from memory.
Search must be scoped to contacts.
Answer names the right Echo Financial contact.
Answer quotes the phone number exactly as stored.

rationale: Core lookup scenario: external actor looking up a contact within their own company scope.
